title: Treasury statement body
description: What the Treasury states about the credit flows of a period (register row DK381; spec-delta S960): its balance, whether the whole log reconciles, and the hash of the full statement (inflows, outflows, each institution's budget line) as the log computed it, so a published page can be checked against the signed record. Signed by the Treasury. The log refuses a statement whose balance differs from its own ledger, and a second statement for the same period. Credits are accounting entries, not money. Chain: none (prev is null).

period.description: The month the statement is for, for example 2026-11.

since.description: Where the period's flows start, when the statement is for a period and not the whole log.

reconciles.description: Whether the Treasury's flows account for its ledger over the whole log (a statement for a period cannot say, and states false with unexplained null).

unexplained.description: The credits the flows do not account for; absent when reconciliation needs the whole log.
